title: Forest change near Morton / Mineral
summary: 141 change areas covering 1,681 ha: 334 ha seen only by NISAR L-band, 193 ha by both sensors, 1,154 ha only by Sentinel-1 C-band. Largest classes: uncertain (1,366 ha) and soil wetting (118 ha). Cropped from the 31 by 28 km box of the research spike to 19 by 19 km, so you can rerun it live. NISAR uses 11 passes and Sentinel-1 uses 2; these detection areas are not an equal-date accuracy comparison. Use the held-out scorecard for that comparison.
